TextBlock.Text: Destroy the coastal radar and stores compound, then extract both strike aircraft. Fictional 2025 operation; requires F-23A Block 40 and Block 40 Strike.
A coastal radar and military stores compound support the raids. Two Block 40 Strike aircraft carry four GBU-12s in total. A Block 40 fighter escorts them. Two enemy fighters patrol inland.

The radar lies east of the strike pair; the stores compound is southeast of the radar. Assign a military target to each strike aircraft. The pair carries laser-guided bombs and Sidewinders; the escort carries long-range air-to-air missiles. A short-range SAM covers the radar.

Destroy both designated targets before bringing BOTH strike aircraft into the sea withdrawal circle at 15,000 feet. The gate activates after target destruction. Nearby civilian communications are protected. Either strike aircraft lost, any neutral loss or the deadline fails the operation. Escort survival earns a bonus.

Your aircraft start airborne and selected, with weapons and fuel loaded. Two-aircraft flights begin in Vic formation. Give route and attack orders to the flight leader, or detach a wingman for independent tasking.

Fictional naval F-23 development in September 2025. The carrier, supporting units and legacy opposition are scenario stand-ins. Radar silence does not guarantee invisibility. Neutral losses anywhere in the scenario fail the operation.
